## Why it matters

- Diversifier logic: the combined Sharpe (1.89) exceeds every individual sleeve (SPY 0.90 / QQQ 1.35 / BTC 1.81) — consistent with real diversification, the tweet's actual claim.
- BTC is the workhorse (best PF 1.81, best t-score per trade history) and SPY the drag: low PF 1.26 with 15.6% DD on 10%/yr.
- **Skepticism gates:** 46%/yr combined on fixed capital with ~289 trades/yr is a strong claim; "fixed starting capital" return math can inflate compounding-style figures vs a margined/compounded account. Win-rate column alignment across sleeves is exactly where OCR (or author) error hides; treat per-sleeve cells as approximate until verified against the source image.
